import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana"],
    "spend": [1500, 800, 1000, 750]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals
df_nw = nw.from_native(df)

# Add "tier" column using when/then/otherwise
df_nw = df_nw.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then(nw.lit("gold")).otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Convert back to native
result = nw.to_native(df_nw)
print(result)
